name: ado-toolkit
description: Azure DevOps Server via the Azure CLI (az + azure-devops extension): /ado-pr reviews, creates, updates and comments on pull requests, /ado-workitem creates, shows, queries, updates and comments on work items (German-localized server), /ado-pipeline analyses build failures and writes changelogs. Works inside a git checkout of an Azure DevOps repository; assumes you are signed in via az devops login (PAT).
